output.summary: Annual flowering herb native to most of the central United States. Its flower heads are brilliant yellow with maroon or brown centres and notched petal tips. The Zuni traditionally used blossoms of the tinctoria variety for mahogany-red dye and, historically, a hot drink.
output.edibilityNote: The Zuni traditionally made a hot beverage from blossoms of the tinctoria variety before traders introduced coffee.
